intro: One small bar of milk chocolate (40 g) has about 210 kcal. The calories come from cocoa butter, milk fat and sugar.
diet: Yes. Chocolate is not the enemy. What matters is the size and how often. Two small squares after a meal is enough to satisfy a sweet craving, at around 55 kcal. The problem is when a big bar is finished in one sitting.
tips: Break the bar into small squares, eat just 2 and keep the rest in the fridge.
Have chocolate after a main meal, not on an empty stomach, so you don't overdo it.
Pair 2 squares with fruit like banana or strawberries so it feels more satisfying.

swap.name: 2 squares dark chocolate + 1 small banana
swap.why: You still get the sweet chocolate taste and a bigger portion, but fewer calories than a milk chocolate bar.

faq.q: Is dark chocolate healthier than milk chocolate?
faq.a: Dark chocolate has less sugar and more cocoa. The calories are about the same, so portion still matters.

faq.q: Why is it so hard to stop eating chocolate?
faq.a: The mix of sugar and fat naturally makes us want more. Portion out a small amount first so it's easier to stop.
It differs from person to person. Some people notice a change, some don't.
